# KAISTEEL

> KAISTEEL creates the Movable Outdoor Social Kitchen for cooking, gathering and entertaining. KAISTEEL LIMITED is the Hong Kong commercial and contracting entity. Production is carried out through an independent manufacturing partner in Guangdong; Guangdong Dingzhi Decoration Design Co., Ltd. provides technical and operational support as a separate legal entity.

## Identity and founder
- Founder Guirong Peng began architectural decoration design and related engineering work in 2001. His Hemei business dates to 2008; Dingzhi was established in 2017. Personal history is not KAISTEEL corporate history.
- BRN 78595271. KAISTEEL LIMITED was formerly GRACE JEWELRY TECH LIMITED; name changed 17 August 2026, same legal entity. Current BR period 8 August 2026–7 August 2027 does not establish original incorporation date.
- Factory identity and relevant credentials can be shared under mutual confidentiality and non-circumvention arrangements without a purchase commitment. Video reviews or independent inspections can be arranged.

## Products
- PRO 2300: motorized roller shutter or motorized lift-up; overall planning dimensions 2300 x 880 x 2400 mm.
- MAX 2900: motorized lift-up, 880 or 960 mm depth, overall height 2400 mm.
- CUSTOM Compact 2278/2878: manual lift-up reference formats, project engineering and quantity review required.
- PRO/MAX base: galvanized-steel frame, aluminium cabinetry/panels and 304 stainless worktop/sink. CUSTOM Compact uses an aluminium frame. 316, stainless cabinetry and stone cladding are component-specific quoted options. No whole-unit stainless claim.
- System Shell, Appliance-Ready and Full Package have distinct scope. Exact appliance model, interfaces, ratings, destination documents and licensed local connections must be confirmed. No blanket whole-system certification.

## Commercial and delivery
- Current product basis: EXW named place, Incoterms 2020; FOB/CIF/DDP quoted separately. Same current EXW reference basis for single units and containers, without an automatic sample surcharge or container discount. Formal quotations control price.
- Standard payment 50% deposit, 50% before shipment. EXW validity 30 calendar days from email dispatch; DDP has its own 15-day validity and destination conditions.
- DDP is address-, configuration- and packing-specific, with no universal US$800 delivery rate or fixed tax percentage. The issued scope specifies included clearance, taxes and delivery services. Customer unloading, positioning, assembly and installation are excluded unless expressly included.
- Target production about 30 days after the agreed payment milestone and written Technical Freeze. Transport time is additional and route-specific.
- Container quantity only from final configuration, measured packing data and the approved Packing Plan. No generic loading guarantee.
- Sample credit is conditional, not permanent or automatic: approved standard PRO/MAX orders confirmed 1 September–31 December 2026; eligible equipment-only credit against a qualifying subsequent full-container equipment order within 6 months after sample shipment; excluded charges and market eligibility follow the written PI. No cash refund.
- Warranty: eligible primary structures up to 15 years, eligible finishes up to 5 years, specified supplied functional components 1 year. Aluminium cabinets/panels/frames are not automatically in the 15-year tier. Appliances follow manufacturer warranties. The applicable order certificate controls.
